value.rationale: The inradius and circumradius are natural complementary Euclidean shadow-size invariants. Their complete coupled law has an unexpected nonzero point atom and sharp unique height-to-diameter co-saturation optimum, with an exact geometric inverse from the enclosing-radius atom. This is not a routine restatement of mean width or projected area; it provides an exact interpretable statistic for random silhouettes and bounding-circle analysis.
